name: Petrify
description: Petrify device discovery, playback handoff and listening-party relay.
overview: Runs the bundled Petrify relay with Jellyfin, with validated network and party timing settings and an optional browser health check.

versions.changelog: Relay 1.2.2: every connected device can vote in Party or Voting mode; any connected device can start or stop a shared session, and a device can leave playback or pause voting only for itself. Host handoff keeps the party alive when its current host leaves. Voting capabilities are reported in health and the client shows per-song device counts.
